## How the guide uses it

On 12 pages. It surfaces most where realignment has made it acute: Sacramento State facing Midwest travel and midweek games after moving to the MAC, a California team playing in the MAC at all, and the reshaped Pac-12 and Mountain West. p. 21 names travel as one of the factors feeding home-field advantage.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

The distance, direction and time-zone change a team must cover to play, and the scheduling burden that follows.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

The 2026 realignment made travel a live variable for whole conferences at once rather than for individual teams, which is why the guide raises it more than the page count suggests.

## How bettors use it in this guide

As a qualitative burden attached to a specific programme's season, and as a stated input to the field ratings without a printed decomposition.
